name: Molly control help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Molly control plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Molly control
entries.text: Everything Molly shows is reachable without the UI. Molly hands the console inside it a list of its screens, tabs, settings and actions; a Claude session, the CLI, MCP or your voice through AmberX names one and the console brings it to Molly.

entries.title: New tab
entries.text: Opens another copy of an app (Console 2) as its own tab, with its own frame. In IDE mode it becomes a dock tab you can drag into a pane.

entries.title: Close this tab
entries.text: Closes the copy on screen. Its frame goes; the app's other copies stay.

entries.title: What is open
entries.text: Says which copies are open, which are on screen and whether IDE mode is on. The same answer goes to axf console where.
